title: Author nothing before the operator ratifies the locked decomposition

facts.note: Needs an observer exposing the plan session's lock state (locked = operator ratified) to agent and verifier.
Needs a tool-call observer detecting who invokes an atdd author writer (agent vs atdd plan) and whether the session was locked at that moment.
Heuristic: task text indicates a decomposition-to-authoring session.
Heuristic: edits to the session machine's author pass, where the lock guard lives.

fires: The decomposition is proposed but not yet ratified, and an atdd author writer is about to be invoked for a unit.
The planner is tempted to call atdd author itself instead of letting atdd plan do it on confirm.
The operator has ratified and the session is locked: authoring must happen via atdd plan per locked unit, not by the agent.
The session machine's author pass (PlanSession.author()) is changed or reviewed.
doesNotFire: Conversation about the decomposition in which no atdd author writer is invoked and no locked unit is authored.
Work outside a plan session (no decomposition-to-authoring flow).

given: A plan session whose decomposition the operator has not yet ratified and locked (the Ratify gate / confirm_boundary: where LLM/operator judgment ends and deterministic authoring begins).
when: Any atdd author <kind> writer would be invoked for a unit of the decomposition.
then: Author nothing until the operator confirms and the decomposition is locked.
prefer: On ratification, let atdd plan (the system, not the agent) deterministically invoke atdd author <kind> per locked unit: complete, atomic, idempotently replayable.
In the session machine, keep the lock guard as the first statement of PlanSession.author(): raise SessionGateError when self.locked is False, before calling any author writer.
avoid: Invoking an atdd author writer yourself, before or after ratification.
An author pass that invokes any writer while the session is unlocked, or a guard moved after the first writer call.
why: Ratify is the conversational-to-deterministic boundary; authoring only from an operator-locked decomposition keeps it complete, atomic and replayable rather than driven by unconfirmed agent judgment.
evidence: No atdd author writer invocation occurs in the session before the lock/ratification event; post-lock invocations come from atdd plan per locked unit.
PlanSession.author() raises SessionGateError when self.locked is False, as its first statement, before any author writer is called.
verifier_detail: Normative: the session machine's author pass MUST refuse to invoke any atdd author writer until the session is locked by the operator's ratification.
Fix hint: PlanSession.author() must raise SessionGateError when self.locked is False, before calling any author writer. Keep the lock guard as the first statement of author().
Term author_on_confirm: on confirm, atdd plan deterministically invokes atdd author per locked unit (complete, atomic, idempotently replayable).
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 3.124.0.

splitSuggestion.then: After ratification, authoring is performed only by atdd plan invoking atdd author per locked unit (complete, atomic, idempotently replayable), never by the agent.

sharedNodes.text: Disposition strict: the rule fails on every finding; no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: Activation facts, fires/doesNotFire situations and heuristic path globs for the session machine.

additions.text: Post-ratification system-owned authoring (atdd plan invokes atdd author per locked unit) is a distinct obligation; kept in prefer[0]/avoid[0] here and suggested as planner.plan.author-on-confirm.
additions.justification: Keeps then to one obligation without losing the S006/S017 requirement.

additions.text: avoid[0] 'before or after ratification' derives from S006 'the system, not the agent' invokes atdd author.
additions.justification: Concrete anti-pattern restating the source; no new obligation.
